See [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) for the full security policy including trusted origins and vulnerability reporting.
> **Goal**: Fix security vulnerabilities and broken pages before any feature work.
VanAgain takes security seriously. This document describes the security measures in place, the HTTP security headers enforced across all routes, and how to report vulnerabilities.

All responses — both dynamic (via Edge Middleware) and static (via `next.config.ts` headers) — include the following headers. The canonical values live in **`lib/security-headers.ts`** so they stay DRY.

| **Content-Security-Policy** | Restrictive allowlist | Controls which origins can serve scripts, styles, images, fonts, frames, and connections. Trusts `*.platphormnews.com` (shipment API / staging), `*.vercel.app`, `*.stripe.com`, and `*.
| **Strict-Transport-Security** | `max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload` | Forces HTTPS for 2 years; enables HSTS preload list eligibility. |
| **Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy** | `unsafe-none` | Required for Stripe and YouTube iframe embeds. |
If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it responsibly:
1. **Email**: Send details to [support@vanagain.com](mailto:support@vanagain.com) with the subject line "Security Vulnerability Report".
2. **Do not** open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.
